svg.text: two-layer caching — L1 skips LLM, L2 reuses KV
L1 — response caching (app-level)
exact lookup → eligible semantic search
scope: authorization + prompt/data version
threshold: calibrate on labeled examples
validate every candidate:
same entity, task, and permitted context
fresh data and compatible response format
no unsafe reuse of side effects
accepted match passes quality criteria
match precision and cache hit rate are different metrics
L2 — serving prefix cache
reuse attention KV for repeated prefix
managed API or self-hosted serving engine
stable instructions and shared context first
dynamic context and question afterward
eligibility, retention, and billing vary
include writes, reads, and output generation
measure cached input tokens and actual cost
self-hosted: balance compute against memory
prefix reuse saves processing; it does not reuse the answer
failure modes to measure
· parallelization penalty
concurrent cold misses can duplicate fills; warmup/coalescing trades latency for reuse
· dynamic content in prefix
changing early tokens limits the shared prefix; earlier compatible blocks may still match
batch and caching economics
verify discount compatibility; price input, output, writes, and storage separately
compare net savings against quality, freshness, and completion deadlines
